plan.topic: Thanksgiving plate on tirzepatide: does eating the turkey and vegetables before the carbs matter? Eating order and your body's own GLP-1
plan.angle: Sentence 1: 'On tirzepatide, should you eat the turkey before the stuffing?' By 6 s: 'In one small study of 16 adults with type 2 diabetes, eating protein and vegetables before carbs was linked to smaller blood sugar rises and a higher GLP-1 response after the meal.' One rounded number at most. Then: it's a habit that may help, not a replacement for the medicine, and no tirzepatide trial tested it. As a separate sentence with no 'so': tirzepatide reduces appetite and food intake. Two untagged tips at most: start with the protein you enjoy, then whatever else you like; go back if you're still hungry. Low blood sugar line: if you have diabetes and take insulin or a sulfonylurea, ask your prescriber about the holiday meal. Close: 'Not personal advice, so ask your prescriber.', then the loop line.
plan.why: Thanksgiving peaks Nov 25–27. A fresh holiday-table angle (eating order and natural GLP-1) that avoids the full-fast, heartburn, drinks, greasy and leftovers Shorts already run. | fact-check: I confirmed the study: Shukla et al., BMJ Open Diabetes Res Care 2017 (PMID 28989726), a randomised crossover in 16 adults with type 2 diabetes. When carbohydrate came last (eaten 10 min after protein and vegetables), glucose iAUC was 53% lower and peaks 54% lower, insulin was lower and GLP-1 excursions were higher than when carbohydrate came first. That's one meal on test days, in people not on tirzepatide. The GLP-1 finding is from type 2 diabetes only. Don't extend it to prediabetes unless you cite a separate study that measured GLP-1 there. Timing: Thanksgiving is 26 Nov 2026, so it must go out before then, with no dates or 'this year' in the narration. The 'Thanksgiving long video' target must actually be live. If it isn't, point to How It Works. No guilt, no calorie talk, no 'bad' foods.

package.title: Tirzepatide: Can You Still Have Stuffing This Thanksgiving? #shorts
package.description:
Thanksgiving plate order on tirzepatide: in one small one-meal study of 16 adults with type 2 diabetes (not on tirzepatide), protein and veg before carbs was linked to smaller blood sugar rises. No tirzepatide trial has tested it.
Diabetes, on insulin or a sulfonylurea? Higher low blood sugar risk, so ask your prescriber.
#Tirzepatide
Not personal advice. Talk to your doctor or prescriber about whether it's right for you.

On tirzepatide, Thanksgiving doesn't mean skipping the stuffing 🦃

But eating order might matter.
In one small study of 16 adults with type 2 diabetes, eating protein and vegetables before carbs was linked to smaller blood sugar rises and a higher GLP-1 response than carbs first.

The catch: one meal, people not on tirzepatide, and no tirzepatide trial has tested this.

Tirzepatide itself decreases calorie intake, likely via appetite. Eating order is a habit that may help, not a replacement for your medicine.

Start with the protein and veggies you enjoy, then whatever you like. Still hungry? Go back.

script.cta: Spoken close: "Not personal advice, so ask your prescriber. And remember:", which loops back to "On tirzepatide, Thanksgiving doesn't mean skipping the stuffing." There is no subscribe line and no "link in the description". Post note (Exp G related-video link): target the Thanksgiving long video, which is live per the 11-20 analytics. If it isn't, use How It Works (nrFCp1PWDW4). Word count: 120 by a word-by-word recount (tight arm, 90–120). Captions must come from on_screen_text only and read "GLP-1", never "G-L-P one".

factcheck.summary:
This Short passes. Every claim matches its source and the safety lines are scoped correctly.

**src1, Shukla et al. 2017, BMJ Open Diabetes Res Care (PMC5604719):** The description holds up.
- It was a randomised crossover study of 16 adults with type 2 diabetes who took metformin only.
- In the carb-last meal, people ate protein and vegetables, rested 10 minutes, then ate the carbs.
- Compared with eating carbs first, incremental glucose area under the curve was 53% lower and the GLP-1 response was greater (p=0.019).
- The script's "linked to", "one small study", "one meal" and "carbs first" comparator all match. "People not on tirzepatide" is accurate: other diabetes medicines were excluded, and the study came out before tirzepatide was approved.

**src2, Zepbound PI section 12.2 (rev 8/2026):** It says, word for word, "Tirzepatide decreases calorie intake. The effects are likely mediated by affecting appetite." s5 keeps that verb and hedge and doesn't link it to eating order.

**src3, Mounjaro PI section 5.3 (rev 8/2026):** It says the risk of low blood sugar is higher with an insulin secretagogue (e.g. sulfonylurea) or insulin. s7 limits the warning to that group, both spoken and on screen.

**Other checks:**
- A recount gives exactly 120 words, inside the tight arm.
- The closing is "Not personal advice, so ask your prescriber." on one card ending in a full stop, with no subscribe line or link-in-description line.
- The hook pays off, and the eating tips are guilt-free with no pressure to restrict.
- No severe-stomach-pain emergency line is needed, because the script doesn't cover fullness, nausea or eating less.

I found no issues.
